scope: Obstfeld and Rogoff (1996), Chapter 6: imperfections in international capital markets. Sovereign risk with direct sanctions and with saving, reputation and trigger strategies over an infinite horizon, Bulow-Rogoff, Worrall convergence, debt ceilings, precommitment and investment, debt overhang and the debt Laffer curve, Rubinstein bargaining, hidden information and moral hazard, with Appendices 6A-6B and the provable exercises.
source: Maurice Obstfeld and Kenneth Rogoff (1996), Foundations of International Macroeconomics, MIT Press, Chapter 6, pp. 349-428.
